scope: The ancient Royal Library of Alexandria in the Ptolemaic capital.
disposition: The ancient Royal Library has no securely identified site, building footprint, or exterior. The Qualla picture depicts Alexandria’s Greek Orthodox Cathedral of the Annunciation.

imagery.reason: The originating description names and identifies a different building.

factualSources.details: Strabo reports a Mouseion with a covered walk, exedra and dining hall in the royal precinct. He supplies no identifiable exterior or plan for the Royal Library.
Getzel M. Cohen’s entry on ancient Alexandria documents uncertainty about the Royal Library site and its physical relationship to the Mouseion.

resumeWhen: A site and architectural source can be securely attributed to the ancient Royal Library. A future hypothetical illustration would need independent labeling and review.
